subject: paperclip
positioning: Open-source orchestration for zero-human companies — 'If OpenClaw is an employee, Paperclip is the company.' Company-sim control plane: org charts, budgets, goals, governance, agent coordination.

language_stack.server: Node.js 20+ / TypeScript, tsx runner, pnpm 9.15.4 workspaces
language_stack.db: PostgreSQL (embedded via embedded-postgres patch, para first-run zero-setup; aponta pro seu Postgres em prod)
language_stack.ui: React UI em ui/ (mencionada no README)

differentiators_observable: Company-sim paradigm: org charts, CEO/CTO/engineers, reporting lines, job descriptions
True multi-company isolation: 'Every entity is company-scoped, so one deployment can run many companies with separate data and audit trails'
Atomic task checkout + budget enforcement (no double-work, no runaway spend)
Heartbeat-based agents (BYOA: OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Bash, HTTP)
Goal-aware execution — tasks carry full goal ancestry
Portable company templates via companies.sh (export/import com secret scrubbing)
Governance with rollback — approval gates + revisioned config
Adapter plugin system (adapter-plugin.md) para BYOA agents
Scheduled Routines, Skills Manager, Agent Reviews and Approvals — marcados como shipped em ROADMAP
Bind presets: local loopback / lan / tailnet (tailscale-friendly)
E2E testing robusto: Playwright + release-smoke + multiuser-authenticated
